title: Wall sit

steps.text: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet about two foot-lengths away from it, shoulder-width apart.
steps.cue: Back on the wall, feet out in front.

steps.text: Slide your back down the wall until your knees are bent. Stop higher than a seated position if that is enough.
steps.cue: Slide down until your knees are bent.

steps.text: Keep your knees over your ankles and your back flat against the wall. Breathe steadily.
Hold for up to 25 seconds, then press through your feet and slide back up.
Shake out your legs and do one more hold.
steps.cue: Shake out your legs. One more hold.

mistakes: Letting the knees move forward past the toes.
regression: Slide down only a little way, and hold for 10 seconds.
stopIf: Stop if you feel pain in your knees, or feel dizzy or light-headed.

anatomy.why: The front of the thigh holds the knees bent without moving.
